checks: Intake requires manual rule confirmation and locked deadlines, checklist, roles and participant threshold cannot be rewritten
Sealed response bytes remain closed before opening even to their creator, file-confidential managers and wildcard administrators
Response material cannot be relabelled, generically versioned or reused as a purchase/publication source
Future opening time and insufficient participant count are server gates rather than display-only warnings
Receipt, preview and opening operations enforce tenant, project and frozen custodian duties
Checklist completeness, unique active receipts, sealed status and evidenced late registration are checked before opening
Actually late material is not silently admitted and replacement retains the withdrawn receipt and original bytes
Changed preview fingerprints and real stored-byte hash mismatch reject opening atomically, leaving the content closed
Formal opening releases exact versions only to explicitly frozen reader duties; creators and another unopened round remain blocked
Opened receipts and intake configuration cannot be rewritten after release
One account gets separate qualification and conformity sheets, and later phases cannot be written or opened prematurely
Phase transition requires full prior submissions, blocks failed objects and requires per-object exclusion reasons without exposing private opinion text
Separate roles can finish sequential phases without deadlock; excluded objects and cross-phase corrections stay blocked after downstream release
Removing the response-read permission also blocks raw downloads of already opened materials
scope: synthetic controlled receipts, offline opening and basic phased assessments; no encrypted e-tender opening or method-specific full procedure
